how_it_works: Implemented under src/sldb/cli/parsers/ as the argparse subcommand 'serve'. It parses the listed arguments and dispatches to its handler in the sldb CLI runtime over the .sldb store.
purpose: The `sldb serve` command: Serve the store over HTTP using the same methods as the CLI.
